types.direction: Evidence or reason to the conclusion it supports
types.example: A source observation supports a mechanism account.
types.counterexample: A repeated summary is not independent support.

types.direction: Evidence or argument to the account it puts in doubt
types.example: A contrary observation challenges an unqualified generalization.

types.direction: Condition or exception to the account it limits
types.example: A wet-room exclusion qualifies a dry-room procedure.
types.counterexample: Qualification does not refute all uses.

types.direction: Dependent account or procedure to its prerequisite
types.example: Applying a rule depends on identifying its intended definition.
types.counterexample: A prerequisite is not automatically a cause.

types.direction: Explanatory mechanism to what it attempts to explain
types.example: A proposed heat-transfer account explains a cooling observation.
types.counterexample: An explanatory proposal is not proven causation.

types.direction: Case to the concept, procedure or mechanism account it illustrates
types.example: A worked case illustrates a mechanism under specified conditions.
types.counterexample: Similarity alone is not an instance; an invented example is not empirical validation.

types.direction: Account or procedure to the context where it applies
types.example: A handling procedure applies to a specified room and device.
types.counterexample: A link does not establish success outside its scope.

types.direction: Derived account to its original input
types.example: A retelling is derived from the original handbook.
types.counterexample: Derivation does not create independent evidence.

extension_policy: Require a concrete case, semantics, migration and retrieval tests; no automatic expansion.
